summary: Iteration 100 — comprehensive frontend-only regression + P0-F.13 acceptance test on /xdr/edr/device-trajectory?device=dev_42e8c6dc74b9. All seven owner requirements PASS with zero console errors and zero passive-listener warnings. WHEEL MAPPING (rows / shift-time / ctrl-zoom) works exactly as specified — the canvas carries data-wheel-navigation='rows|shift-time|ctrl-zoom', plain wheel changes 'rows X–Y of 491' while amp-nav-window stays fixed, shift+wheel scrubs the window (24.0h → later date, rows unchanged), ctrl+wheel shrinks the span from 24.0h to 6.3h, and window.scrollY stays 0 (background page never scrolls). SHOW DETAILS drawer opens with all 17 required testids populated correctly (hostname, device-iid, endpoint-id, LINUX, connector 0.1.0, ENROLLED, REPORTING, group/policy/int-ip/ext-ip/definitions all as 'not collected', observations 6356, lanes 491, related-compromise '4 compromise event(s)…', vulnerabilities), URL is unchanged, and both amp-details-drawer-close and amp-details-drawer-backdrop close it cleanly. DETECTION→TRAJECTORY: /xdr/edr/device-trajectory?device=dev_42e8c6dc74b9&at=2026-09-06T12:14:07.050000%2B00:00 opens amp-details-panel with amp-details-timestamp exactly '2026-09-06T12:14:07.050000+00:00', amp-nav-window centred as 'window 30.0 min · 2026-09-06 11:59:07 → 2026-09-06 12:29:07 UTC', and back+select a different event switches timestamp to 12:14:10.950000+00:00 — the ?at anchor does NOT re-hijack. ?event=<iid> deep link also reselects exactly. PID+LINEAGE labels are correct — 'bash (1) [Proc]', 'timeout (81755) [Proc]', 'python3.11 (81757) [Proc]' with pid, and 'replay-probe [Proc]' honestly omits the pid where not reported. 31 amp-connector-* elements are present in the initial slice with data-parent-lane-index attributes matching the lineage tree (5→4, 6→5, 7→6, 8→6, 9→6…). ACTIVITY TABS render All/Processes/Files/Network/Detections with counts, and switching tabs does not alter amp-nav-window nor the row range (amp-status['rows X–Y of 491'] unchanged). REGRESSION SWEEP: deep vscroll at 100·15, 300·15, 430·15 all render real amp-event-*/amp-lifeline-*/amp-connector-*; theme toggle persists 'light' across reload via localStorage nvf-amp-theme; 24-hour bin-hit repositions the trajectory to a 30 min window; filters→detection reduces amp-filter-count to '4 / 6356 observations' and renders 4 amp-compromise-marker-*; fullscreen toggles; legacy /edr/trajectory, /edr, /edr/detections, /edr/process-tree, /edr/campaign-story all load with HTTP 200. All three iteration-99 findings are FIXED: (a) amp-status footer text now reads '… wheel scrolls the activity axis · shift-wheel scrubs time · ctrl-wheel zooms the window …' which is accurate under the new mapping; (b) preventDefault-inside-passive warnings — ZERO occurrences (native non-passive listener works); (c) React border shorthand warnings — ZERO occurrences.

ui_bugs.issue: The Processes tab shows only '33 in this window' without the ' · M shown' suffix, whereas Files/Network/Detections tabs correctly show '33 in this window · 0 shown'. Minor inconsistency — because on the Processes tab N==M, the code appears to suppress the suffix. Request wording ('N in this window · M shown') suggests the suffix should always be present so the analyst never has to remember which tab hides it. Cosmetic only.

issues: Dark and Light themes both fully legible in header strip, drawer, actions menu, gutter labels, connectors, event glyphs, compromise markers, activity list and details pane. No white-on-white or dark-on-dark elements observed.

action_items: OPTIONAL / LOW: consider always emitting the ' · M shown' suffix in amp-activity-count so the format is consistent across all five activity tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: AmpCanvas wheel handler is now correctly attached via addEventListener('wheel', h, {passive:false}) — the previous preventDefault-inside-passive warning is gone. Good fix.
The three iteration-99 findings (footer copy, passive wheel, border shorthand) are all resolved with zero console errors and zero warnings across all tested flows.

Row labels correctly include PID+tag when known and honestly omit PID when not reported ('replay-probe [Proc]'). Tooltip on each label already exposes lineage depth and first/last timestamps — excellent affordance for identical process names.

success_rate.frontend: ~99% (7/7 owner acceptance items pass; 1 LOW cosmetic remark)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything owner-required passes on iteration 100 with zero console errors. The details drawer at [data-testid=amp-details-drawer] is a right-side drawer with an amp-details-drawer-backdrop that also closes it. amp-details-drawer-close is the drawer's X (do not confuse with amp-details-back, which is the Activity Details panel's back arrow).
